Klink Cycles Social Ride

Eugene, OR · Whiteaker · Social

Beginner friendlyFamily

Klink Cycles Social Ride is a social group ride in Eugene, OR. It rolls first Wednesday and Third Wednesday of the month at 6:30 pm from Klink Cycles. Pace: social.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: social.
Check
Look at @klinkcycles the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Klink Cycles Social Ride group ride

A shop social ride on the first and third Wednesday, rain or shine. All ages, bodies and abilities welcome. Details for each ride go out on the shop's Instagram.
